cycle.description: Phoenix 138-year cycle per the Archaix/Chronicon thesis (Jason Breshears) as used in the Phoenix CODEX 138 project. Phoenix years fall on multiples of 138 Anno Mundi counted from Year One (3895 BC = AM 1); 43 such passes run to 2040 (AM 5934 = 138 x 43). Every fourth Phoenix is a flood (552-year chain: 2239, 1687, 1135, 583 BC). The engine pairs it with Metonic 19, NER 600, Nemesis 792, the 144,000-day baktun and the sar.

anchorNotes.-5239: Chronicon count origin (Nemesis/Great Year count opens); 7,344 years to 2106
anchorNotes.-2239: Great Flood, AM 1656 = 138 x 12 (the hinge/mirror centre)
anchorNotes.1902: Last documented Phoenix, AM 5796 = 138 x 42 (Mont Pelee / Red Mud)
anchorNotes.2106: AM 6000 capstone year; Nemesis 792 loop from 3439 BC also lands here

cycle.yearNumbering: BC years are stored as negative integers exactly as the sources' own sortYear fields do: N BC = -N, so 1 BC = -1 and there is NO year zero (1 BC is followed by AD 1). This is historical BC/AD numbering written with a minus sign, NOT astronomical numbering (astronomical year = -(N-1), i.e. 1 BC = 0). The sources state the Chronicon rule AD = AM - 3894 and do BC arithmetic as 3895 - AM; the station sheets note the Long Count zero '11 August 3114 BC ... astronomical year -3113', which Chronicon lists as 3113 BCE. Fractional sortYears in the sources (e.g. 1932.5, 2026.74) were used only for ordering and are rounded down here.

events.title: THE FIRST FIRE / THE GREAT YEAR BEGINS
events.summary: A fire crosses the sky and the Chronicon count opens: 1,344 years before Year One, 7,344 years (3 x 2,448) to 2106; the 600-year Great Year and a binary sun with a smaller Daystar.

events.title: SHADOW ENTERS THE CIRCLE / THE DAYSTAR GOES DARK
events.summary: Chronoliths begin as a shadow first enters a stone circle's centre; the smaller sun collapses into a dark companion (Nemesis), the Kuiper Belt its wreckage. 930 years after 5239.

events.title: THE CAPTURE OF LUNA
events.summary: After 270 frozen years Earth drifts into the Sun's system and takes up the Moon; Chronicon says Ussher's 4004 BC creation is 109 years off.

events.title: YEAR ONE
events.summary: Banishment from the walled garden; Anno Mundi 1, 6,000 years to 2106. Counted 1,656 years back from the 2239 BC Flood. AD = AM - 3894.
events.source: chronologists-machine/src/data/stations.json M03; ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json C04; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json THE BLACK FLAT; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: THE FIRST PHOENIX
events.summary: Phoenix completes its first 138-year orbit after Year One; a calendar remembers what people forget. Hebrew epoch listed by Chronicon at 3760 BCE (135 AM).
events.source: ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json C05; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json A CALENDAR REMEMBERS; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: SALT WHERE THE SEA WAS
events.summary: Phoenix 2: salt where the sea had been, nothing left to burn, yet the air smells of smoke.

events.title: THE QUIET ONE
events.summary: Phoenix 3: red rain and nothing else; a quiet pass nobody writes down.

events.title: THE WATCHERS DESCEND / THE ARCS
events.summary: Nemesis X completes a 792-year orbit; fifty Watchers descend on Hermon; the Gihon floods a third of the earth in Enosh's days. 2239 + 1,200 = 3439; 2239 - 792 = 1447 BC.

events.title: THE SLOW MUD
events.summary: Phoenix 4: the mud came slowly enough to run from, but they did not; a cook fire still burns beneath it.

events.title: THE FIRST CYCLE CLOSES
events.summary: Four passes, 552 years; 5,448 years remain to 2106, read as the Great Pyramid's height in inches without its capstone.

events.title: THE FIRST ACCOUNTS
events.summary: Core Claim 3: seals and proto-writing are dated 3500-3100 BC everywhere but Gobekli Tepe. Uruk IV tablets (~3350 BC) are the oldest writing known.

events.title: LIGHTS ON THE MOUNTAIN
events.summary: Phoenix 5: lights on the mountain; they came down, were called gods, and led us.

events.title: ENOCH'S THIRD YEAR
events.summary: Phoenix passes in the third regnal year of Enoch, the first to write down the signs of heaven (364-day year); 'the planet of chronology and the chronologist'.

events.title: THE ŠAR
events.summary: Engine constant: the Sumerian sar = 3,600; Berossus's 120 sars (432,000) read as days are three baktuns. Archaix reads the sar as a day's turning of the stars.

events.title: NEWGRANGE
events.summary: The Sethites raise Carnac, Newgrange and Stonehenge I in Enoch's 45th year; Newgrange's roof-box aimed at winter-solstice sunrise c. 3150 BC.

events.title: THE LONG COUNT BEGINS
events.summary: Day zero of the Mayan Long Count (13.0.0.0.0 4 Ahau 8 Kumk'u); Chronicon reads the count in days and closes it in 2046, not 2012.

events.title: THE BLACK AGE
events.summary: Kali Yuga opens, ten years after the Long Count zero; Kali is time; the Persians remember a flood; Manetho's 36,525-year chronicle (25 Sothic cycles).

events.title: BUILDING THE CLOCK
events.summary: Phoenix 6: they lay the line with water; 828 years and six cycles in, they are building the clock.

events.title: THE MIDPOINT
events.summary: 828 years after Year One and 828 before the Flood: a Phoenix pass at the exact centre of the antediluvian count (3895 - 6 x 138).

events.title: ADAM DIES
events.summary: Adam dies at 930 AM and orders burial at the middle of the earth; Chronicon argues he had lived since 4039 BC (1,074 years).

events.title: THE QUARRY
events.summary: Phoenix 7: they were still cutting stone the week it passed; the stone did not notice.

events.title: THE ALTAR IS BEGUN
events.summary: The Sethites begin the Great Pyramid 666 years before the Flood, four corners first then inward; slope 51°51'52".

events.title: OPH_PI
events.summary: Engine constant OPH_PI = 3.14 ('Archaix pi'): base 440 cubits, height 280, 2 x 440 / 280 = 22/7.

events.title: MUD BRICK
events.summary: The Great Pyramid already finished while others still build in mud brick, before the kings who claim it.

events.title: THE ALTAR IS FINISHED
events.summary: Great Pyramid complete after 90 years (1,080 months) in 1080 AM; perimeter 3,024 ft; 203 courses, top left off 'for later'; no body, no inscription, only numbers.
events.source: ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json C15; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json OFF-CYCLE TWO HUNDRED THREE COURSES (AM 1081) and ONLY NUMBERS; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: OPH_PHI
events.summary: Engine constant OPH_PHI = 1.618: slant height over half-base at 51°52' is the golden ratio (Kepler triangle).

events.title: RED DUST
events.summary: Phoenix 8: dust eating the monument from the top down; 1,104 years and still counting.

events.title: ASWAN
events.summary: Copper and sand, they say; but the drill groove advances a tenth of an inch every turn.

events.title: NOBODY HOME
events.summary: Phoenix 9: every door open, every fire lit, nobody home; they went to the next cycle.

events.title: THE SUMERIAN CATASTROPHE
events.summary: Phoenix pass 414 years before the Flood, matched to Sitchin's Sumerian cataclysm; sky dark at noon over Saqqara. One Cursed Earth.

events.title: THE EXODUS OF THE ANUNNA
events.summary: Nemesis X returns after 792 years; the Anunna withdraw for 732 years; the Hurrians build Urkesh.

events.title: KHUFU FOUND THEM
events.summary: The stela says Khufu found the monuments here, repairing the Sphinx, not carving it.

events.title: WRONG BUILDER
events.summary: Phoenix 10: a pharaoh walks to a monument older than his name. Wrong builder, right story.

events.title: A BROWN SUN
events.summary: Phoenix 11: noon under a brown sun; the barley ripens anyway.

events.title: THE LAST PASS
events.summary: Phoenix's final orbit before the Flood, 138 years out; mirror of 4033 BCE, 138 years before Year One.

events.title: THE GREAT FLOOD
events.summary: AM 1656 = 138 x 12, the twelfth Phoenix; 1,656 years after Year One and before the Medo-Lydian eclipse; first link of the 552-year flood chain; the mirror's centre.
events.source: ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json C19, F01; chronologists-machine/src/data/stations.json M05, M06, M07, M08; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json THE FLOOD; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: DIGGING OUT
events.summary: Phoenix 13: survivors dig out with their hands; every cycle someone digs out and calls it history.

events.title: THE GROUND REMEMBERS
events.summary: Phoenix 14: no scripture keeps the date, the ground does; Jason's charts call it worldwide.

events.title: A RUST MOON
events.summary: Phoenix 15: the Moon turns the colour of rust, and only one man writes it down.

events.title: THE FLOOD OF OGYGES
events.summary: AM 2208 = 138 x 16; 552 years after the Flood, second link of the chain. Comet glow over a darkened sun; Attica under water; moai, Baalbek and Aswan quarries left mid-cut.
events.source: ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json F02, E08; chronologists-machine/src/data/stations.json M09; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: THERA
events.summary: Phoenix 17: Thera goes up; no witness wrote it down, but someone watched.

events.title: EARLY EXODUS (ARC)
events.summary: 2239 - 792 = 1447 BC, the early Exodus date, struck from AM 1656 by the 792-year arc.

events.title: ONE VALLEY
events.summary: Phoenix 18: it burned one valley and spared the next; ours was spared, this time.

events.title: KADESH
events.summary: Phoenix 19, AM 2622 = 19 x 138 = 138 Metonic cycles; two armies with every face turned up; the year after Ramesses II fought at Kadesh.

events.title: THE AXIS
events.summary: Phoenix 20 (AM 2760), third flood-chain link and midpoint of the 43 fires; Atlantis goes under and the Bronze Age ends.

events.title: THE SWORD
events.summary: Phoenix 21: a shepherd king's tent on a hill; nothing kept but the count.

events.title: ASSYRIA MARCHES
events.summary: Phoenix 22: Assyria marches; the dust ahead of them is not their own.

events.title: TEN TRIBES
events.summary: Phoenix 23: ten tribes walk out of the record and never walk back in.

events.title: THE MEDO-LYDIAN DARK
events.summary: Phoenix 24, AM 3312 = 138 x 24, fourth flood-chain link: the sun goes out over the Halys and Medes and Lydians stop fighting. Thales called (remembered) it; book rounds 2 years.

events.title: TIME, TIMES, AND HALF A TIME
events.summary: Important MSRF set (1260, 2520): Daniel's time, times and half a time = 1,260 days; Babylon falls to Cyrus.

events.title: THE PRIESTS GUESS
events.summary: Two thousand years after the builders, a Greek asks the priests, and the priests guess.

events.title: THE WALLS AGAIN
events.summary: Phoenix 25: one hand on the stone, one on the spear; they always build the walls again.

events.title: NINETEEN YEARS, TWO HUNDRED THIRTY-FIVE MOONS
events.summary: Engine's Metonic wheel: Meton announces the 19-year cycle on the Pnyx; 19 years hold 235 moons, drifting about two hours per round.

events.title: A RUST SKY
events.summary: Phoenix 26: galleys under a rust sky, waiting for a wind that is not coming.

events.title: THE GOLD GOES DOWN
events.summary: Phoenix 27: the gold is carried down the steps, taken, just like that.

events.title: JUDEA AND ACTIUM
events.summary: Phoenix 28: an earthquake in Judea and Actium burning on the same water, the same spring.

events.title: THE BENNU
events.summary: Core Claim 14: bird plus disc is the Bennu, the Phoenix. Tacitus reports a phoenix seen in Egypt in 34 AD; Herodotus says it returns every 500 years.

events.title: THE GREAT YEAR
events.summary: Engine's NER wheel, 600 years a turn: Josephus writes that the great year completes in 600 years; 5239 to 2239 BC is five turns.

events.title: THE WRONG SUN
events.summary: Phoenix 29: every face turned up at the wrong sun; the sky counts cycles.

events.title: THE SOTHIC RETURN
events.summary: Normal MSRF set (1461): Censorinus records a new Sothic period in 139 AD when Sirius rose with the sun on 1 Thoth.

events.title: CARTS AT THE GATE
events.summary: Phoenix 30: the carts of the dead at the gate; it always follows the sky (transcript: 'Plagefolos').

events.title: A TIMESTAMP
events.summary: Phoenix 31: the northern sky burns; they will call it an omen, but it is a timestamp.

events.title: LIGHT WITHOUT BRIGHTNESS
events.summary: Phoenix 32: a sun with light but no brightness, frosts in summer; thirty-two down, eleven left.

events.title: THE CAMELS KNOW
events.summary: Phoenix 33, a quiet one: the sun dim enough to look at; the camels know before we do.

events.title: DRAGONS, THEY WROTE
events.summary: Phoenix 34: fire in the sky over the monastery; they wrote 'dragons' instead of the date.

events.title: ELDGJA
events.summary: Phoenix 35: Iceland splits open, fire for months, and the sun goes pale over Europe.

events.title: THE KINGFISHER
events.summary: Core Claim 15: the bird plucking a fish carries one meaning from Cyprus to Nazca to New Mexico (Mimbres bowls, c. 1000-1130 AD).

events.title: EMPTY SCAFFOLDS
events.summary: Phoenix 36: a cathedral half built, scaffolds empty; they will finish it and forget why they stopped.

events.title: SOMETIMES MEN
events.summary: Phoenix 37: the plain is full of horsemen; sometimes the sky sends men.

events.title: THE DARK ONE'S LOOP
events.summary: Engine's Nemesis wheel, 792 years: steps from 3439 BC reach 522, 1314 and 2106 AD; the Great Famine's unrelenting rains begin in spring 1315.

events.title: TWICE NINETEEN
events.summary: Phoenix 38 (twice 19): a stinking mist out of the east, and then the dying.

events.title: DRUMS ON THE TEMPLE
events.summary: Phoenix 39: drums on the temple; listen to the rhythm, they are counting it too.

events.title: CROSSES ON THE DOORS
events.summary: Phoenix 40: crosses on the doors, a lantern in the fog; three to go.

events.title: THE UNFINISHED
events.summary: Core Claim 8: work at the moai quarry, Baalbek and Aswan stopped at once in 1687 BC. Roggeveen sights Rapa Nui; ~400 moai remain in Rano Raraku.

events.title: NINETEEN GUNS
events.summary: Phoenix 41: cannon on the quay firing at a sky like a dying coal.

events.title: NO KING, NO BODY
events.summary: They called it the King's Chamber, but there was no king and no body: call it the upper chamber.

events.title: IT RINGS
events.summary: 'Sarcophagus' means flesh-eater, yet it never ate anyone: a granite coffer that rings when struck.

events.title: THE BUCKET & THE CONE
events.summary: Core Claim 12: the 'handbag' is a bucket and the 'pine cone' the palm, badges of the apkallu's office. Layard opens Nimrud.

events.title: THE TABLETS
events.summary: Core Claim 4: rongorongo is used to date Easter Island young. Eyraud first reports the tablets; one dated in 2024 to the 15th century.

events.title: THROUGH SOLID ROCK
events.summary: 345 feet at 26 degrees 31 minutes, through solid rock.

events.title: THE MERIDIAN WINK
events.summary: The Resonance Clock's wink sits on the Giza meridian: apex at 29.9792 N echoes light's 299,792,458 m/s; Piazzi Smyth surveys the pyramid.

events.title: WHEN THE STONE STOPS BREATHING
events.summary: He measures at night when the stone stops breathing, to a thousandth of an inch, never bettered.

events.title: THE VORTEX IS 1089
events.summary: The Vortex MSRF set (21.7, 32.6, 43.5...) is 1089 in disguise, the reversal constant; 1089 x 9 = 9801.

events.title: THE SCORPION KING
events.summary: Core Claim 18: the scorpion is protection, never a threat (Serket, the Girtablilu). Scorpion Macehead found at Hierakonpolis.

events.title: RED MUD / SHADOW LEAVES THE CIRCLE
events.summary: Phoenix 42, AM 5796, last documented step: Mont Pelee erases Saint-Pierre (8 May); red mud, 'the harvest begins'; chronoliths end. 1902 + 138 = 2040.
events.source: chronologists-machine/src/data/stations.json M11; ere-we-were-remotion/stations.json K02; films/data/AllClips_Chyrons_v1.json RED MUD; films/data/AllClips_Transcripts_v2.json

events.title: THE FAT GODDESS
events.summary: Core Claim 6: Malta's Tarxien repeats Gobekli Tepe's enclosures, relief technique and goddess. Zammit excavates 1915-1919.
Closing sequence: 19 x 91 = 1,729 (Hardy's taxi to Ramanujan); 138 + 831 = 969, Methuselah's years.

events.title: THE KING LIST
events.summary: Core Claim 13: Enki = Etana = Enoch, who left earth on a winged object leaving seven apkallu. Weld-Blundell Prism names Etana who ascended.

events.title: THE CAGED SUN
events.summary: Core Claim 17: the Ashanti tale of the bird that brought the sun encodes the vapour-canopy sky; Rattray publishes it.

events.title: THE BENNETT MONOLITH
events.summary: Core Claim 9: Tiwanaku repeats the folded-finger pose, T-face and bucket-holding figures. Bennett unearths a 7.3 m monolith.

events.title: THE COMPARISON
events.summary: Core Claim 11: Hittite eyes, boustrophedon rows and rongorongo signs match Indus seals; de Hevesy's comparison read to the Academie.

events.title: THE TRENCH
events.summary: Core Claim 2: Kenyon's Pre-Pottery Neolithic scheme frames all Near-Eastern dating; she digs Jericho 1952-1958.

events.title: OPH_CRV
events.summary: Engine constant OPH_CRV = 5.08 (curvature) = 3.14 x 1.618, also exactly two inches in cm since the inch was fixed at 25.4 mm.

events.title: THE VULTURE SHRINE
events.summary: Core Claim 19: the vulture is the phoenix; Neolithic head removal is soul-rescue, not violence. Mellaart's Catalhoyuk vulture murals.

events.title: THE DOOR IN THE WALL
events.summary: Core Claim 10: kivas, the sipapu, King Annacus and the underground cities; a wall knocked through opens Derinkuyu.

events.title: THE CROW IN THE SUN
events.summary: Core Claim 16: crows and ravens are sun-darkening (three-legged crow, Hou Yi, Amaterasu). Lady Dai's banner shows a crow in the sun.

events.title: THE FIRST SEASON
events.summary: Core Claim 1: the sites are underground because of cataclysm, not deliberate burial. Schmidt opens Gobekli Tepe under up to 15 m of fill.

events.title: THE JADE PIG
events.summary: Core Claim 7: Lingjiatan and Liangzhu repeat the boar, mouth style and animal poses, 5,000 years younger; an 88 kg jade pig over tomb 07M23.

events.title: THE SEALED HOLLOW
events.summary: A sealed hollow the length of the gallery, still keeping records we cannot read yet.

events.title: THE SEATED MAN
events.summary: Core Claim 5: Karahan Tepe carries an apkallu supporting a winged disc. A 2.3 m seated man and a vulture statue announced September 2023.

events.title: THIRTY-TWO YEARS TO THE DAY
events.summary: 19 January 2023: entering the Great Pyramid, 'thirty-two years to the day'; start of the 1,656-day (138 x 12) span to the 2 August 2027 eclipse.

events.title: THE CAST
events.summary: Manual's worked cast: X1 4 Jul 2026, X2 20 Aug, Y 47 days; operation 9 (X2 + Y x phi) lands on 4 November 2026.

events.title: THE HEPTA-CYCLE
events.summary: OPH_HEP = 7.01: seven Metonics (133) fall five short of a Phoenix (138); the missing capstone is the fifth corner.

events.title: THE SIX WHEELS
events.summary: Resonance Clock: Metonic 19, Phoenix 138, NER 600, Nemesis 792, baktun, sar; 19 & 138 mesh at 2,622, 138 & 600 at 13,800, 138 & 792 at 18,216.

events.title: TODAY HAS NINETEEN NAMES
events.summary: 26 September 2026 in nineteen calendars, including 15 Tishri 5787, Long Count 13.0.13.17.7, and 5920 AM by Chronicon.

witnesses.name: Natori
witnesses.era: Narrator/walker in the films (co-author credit: Natori Saira Evren)
witnesses.testimony: Walks every station and speaks its date; on 2040 says 'This is the one I haven't seen.'
eventRefs: RED MUD / SHADOW LEAVES THE CIRCLE

witnesses.name: Rogue
witnesses.testimony: Second voice at each station; answers on 2040 'I have.' and is told 'Someone watched. You.' at Thera.

witnesses.name: The Chronologist (Codex)
witnesses.testimony: Gives the margin for the next fire: as early as 2039, as late as 2046 for the worst of it (projection, see projections 2039/2040/2046).

witnesses.name: Bradley Rogue (addressed as 'you')
witnesses.testimony: Entered the Great Pyramid the morning of 19 January 2023; returning under the 2 August 2027 Luxor eclipse, 1,656 days later.

witnesses.name: Jason Breshears
witnesses.testimony: His Chronicon and charts supply the chronology (5239 BC count, 3895 BC Year One, Phoenix 138, Nemesis 792); 'Jason's charts call it worldwide' (1963 BC).

witnesses.name: Thales
witnesses.testimony: Foretold the eclipse that stopped the Medo-Lydian battle on the Halys; the film says he did not predict it, he remembered.

witnesses.name: Herodotus
witnesses.testimony: Records day becoming night mid-battle and both sides making peace (1.74); records the phoenix returning to Heliopolis every 500 years (2.73).

witnesses.name: Tacitus
witnesses.testimony: Reports a phoenix seen in Egypt in 34 AD and discusses a cycle of 1,461 years.

witnesses.name: Josephus
witnesses.testimony: Says the patriarchs lived six hundred years because 'the great year is completed in that interval'.
eventRefs: THE FIRST FIRE / THE GREAT YEAR BEGINS

witnesses.name: Meton of Athens
witnesses.testimony: Set up a sun-tracker on the Pnyx and announced the nineteen-year cycle: 19 years hold 235 moons.
eventRefs: NINETEEN YEARS, TWO HUNDRED THIRTY-FIVE MOONS

witnesses.name: Varro
witnesses.testimony: Dates the flood of Ogyges to about 1600 BC.

witnesses.name: Julius Africanus
witnesses.testimony: Dates the flood of Ogyges c. 1796 BC.

witnesses.name: Censorinus
witnesses.testimony: Records that a new Sothic period began in 139 AD when Sirius rose with the sun on 1 Thoth; quotes Varro on Ogyges.

witnesses.name: Plato
witnesses.testimony: Has Atlantis sink in a single day and night.

witnesses.name: Xenophon
witnesses.testimony: Described Anatolian houses dug underground.

witnesses.name: Berossus
witnesses.testimony: Gives the ten kings before the Flood 120 sars, 432,000 years.

witnesses.name: Manetho
witnesses.testimony: His 'Old Chronicle' spans 36,525 years, twenty-five Sothic cycles of 1,461.

witnesses.name: Aryabhata
witnesses.testimony: His reckoning puts the Kali Yuga epoch at 17/18 February 3102 BC, ten years after the Long Count zero.

witnesses.name: Enoch
witnesses.testimony: First to write down the signs of heaven by the order of their months; a 364-day year. Chronicon makes him a king whose 3rd year is a Phoenix pass.

witnesses.name: Khufu (per the stela)
witnesses.testimony: The stela says Khufu found the monuments already there, repairing the Sphinx, not carving it.

witnesses.name: James Ussher
witnesses.testimony: Put creation at 4004 BC, which Chronicon calls 109 years off.

witnesses.name: Klaus Schmidt
witnesses.testimony: Recognised the T-pillars in 1994 and opened excavation of Gobekli Tepe in 1995; enclosures under up to 15 m of fill.

witnesses.name: Lee Clare
witnesses.testimony: With colleagues, since 2018 questions the deliberate-backfill reading of Gobekli Tepe, proposing slope-slide and natural infill.

witnesses.name: Kathleen Kenyon
witnesses.testimony: Dug Tell es-Sultan 1952-1958 and defined the Pre-Pottery Neolithic A and B phases.

witnesses.name: Brother Eugène Eyraud
witnesses.testimony: His December 1864 letter is the first report of the rongorongo tablets.

witnesses.name: Necmi Karul
witnesses.testimony: Leads excavation since 2019; team announced a 2.3 m seated man and life-size vulture statue in September 2023.

witnesses.name: Themistocles Zammit
witnesses.testimony: Excavated the Tarxien temples 1915-1919 after farmers struck the stones in 1913.

witnesses.name: Jacob Roggeveen
witnesses.testimony: Sighted Rapa Nui on Easter Sunday, 5 April 1722, a hill full of half-cut giants.

witnesses.name: Wendell C. Bennett
witnesses.testimony: Unearthed the 7.3 m monolith holding a kero beaker and snuff tablet in the semi-subterranean temple.

witnesses.name: Guillaume de Hevesy
witnesses.testimony: Compared rongorongo signs with Indus Valley seal signs; read to the Academie by Paul Pelliot; later rejected but on record.

witnesses.name: Paul Pelliot

openQuestions: codex/PhoenixCODEX138.txt (the named 'main source', 65 KB) is not working notes: it is the HTML of the 'Bradley Rogue Ventures' portfolio page. Its only cycle data is the Phoenix countdown to 2040-05-16. README calls it 'working notes', so the wrong file may be checked in. Nearly all data here comes from the two stations.json files and films/data chyrons/transcripts.

The year-conversion rule changes between sources, giving off-by-one years. Chyrons give Phoenix 4/5/6/9/11 as 3344/3206/3068/2654/2378 BC; the station sheets give 3343/3205/3067/2653/2377 BC (3895 - AM). Phoenix 1 (3757) and 12+ BC match.

On the AD side, chyrons for Phoenix 29-41 equal AM - 3895 (107, 245, 383, 521 ... 1763). The stated rule AD = AM - 3894 (which 1902/2040/2106 follow) would give 108, 246, 384, 522 ... 1764. Station K03 gives 384 AD for AM 4278, but the chyron says 383.
4309 BC is called 'Phoenix Year 1' in C02, but C05 calls 3757 BC 'the first Phoenix' and chyrons number Phoenix 1 = AM 138 = 3757 BC.
2815 BC (pyramid finished) is 1080 AM in C15 but AM 1081 in the chyrons ('OFF-CYCLE').
Phoenix 2040 date: the site countdown targets 2040-05-16, but the film transcript says 'May 17th, 2040'.
The Medo-Lydian eclipse: the chart says 583 BC, while the station notes record 585 BC astronomically. The sources call this the book rounding. Ogyges is 1687 BC; the M09 caption reads 1688.

C10 equates Chronicon's 3113 BCE with astronomical year -3113 (= 3114 BC). That suggests at least some Chronicon BCE labels may be astronomical. This file stores all BC labels as -N with no year zero.

Transcripts are auto-generated and garbled ('Fails' = Thales?, 'Pilea erases sampier', 'hikesos', 'Kadath', 'Acton', 'Plagefolos', 'Justiny and Sun', 'Harajan', 'A lesion'). Summaries avoid relying on the garbled words; the 245 AD 'plague' tag rests on 'Plagefolos'.
Nibiru appears only in the portfolio page's word-highlighter, never with a date, so no event is tagged Nibiru.

Witness scope: people quoted in the 'anchor'/'claim' text are included. Names that appear only as bibliography in 'check' fields (e.g. Hodder, Lehner, Kitchen, Jordan, Nissen) are excluded. The film's unnamed 'Greek' (450 BC) and the 1881 'He measures' figure are left unnamed.
The station 'check' fields contain mainstream counterpoints (e.g. no global flood layer, dates of Gobekli/Stonehenge). Per instructions these are not used to correct the framework's dates.
Some station years are nominal display years for undated items (e.g. K11 2026.5, K17 2026.7, K19 2026.74, E11 1932.5). They are rounded down to integers here.
